fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-13 11:30 to 2026-11-14 11:30 UTC
Pause: running (the 2026-11-13 report now carries your 👍).

1. Decisions for you: one new, four carried (each a proposed decision in the group log).
- NEW. May the group merge a Door 3 revision that only executes a ratified ruling? (de6b88c5, Answers SP-02). Fact: five Door 3 revisions of Accepted RFCs, each executing a ruling you already ratified, were escalated by the reviewer and set to your merge (srs#1033, #1034, #1035, #1036, #1037). Why it matters: your act each time is merging words you already chose, while real judgement waits. Options: (a) every Door 3 stays yours; (b) the group merges one that cites a ratified ruling and adds no meaning, confirmed by the reviewer; (c) (b) as a 30-day trial. Recommendation: (c). Action: decide. Urgency: low (the PRs can simply be merged by you; srs#1034 also needs its PR classification fixed).
- Field identity rules (21b6b4b7, srs#236, 15 days): srs#1016 landed 9 Nov, so it may be answered in practice. Recommendation: rule on it or close it as overtaken. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Heading-outline continuity (864eaebf, srs#991, 15 days): one rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Recommendation: one rule, after a downstream audit. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Is editor UI in the mandate (bc6bc746, srs-web#691, 10 days): recommendation: route it to WG Agent-supported editor. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- `note delete` default (c7a8e0a2, srs-rust#1497, 17 days): refuse notes with inbound Relations unless `--cascade`. Recommendation: approve. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
Also waiting for your merge (Action: approve): srs#1033, #1034, #1035, #1036, #1037, all `gate:owner-merge`, each citing its ruling (ba478783, 7753b32f, 6114cc72, e36be60a, 7324ac6f).

2. Decided within mandate: none ratified this cycle. The three merged PRs name mandates in their quorum lines (rulings and ADR-057), not proposed group decisions; no group session was held.

3. Done: 3 PRs merged, all `gate:auto-merge`:
- srs-rust#1662 package imports gets diagnosticsStructured (#1339, slice 11): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / mandate 00567bf1/bf4a5af5.
- srs-rust#1661 diagnosticsStructured beside find-by-target-type diagnostics (#1339, slice 8): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / mandate ADR-057.
- srs-rust#1640 publish srs-bindings to npm from promoted releases (#819): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / mandate 012d961f.
Issues that may now close with their landed PRs: srs-rust#1622, #1505, #1411, #728, #731, srs#928 (from earlier reports, still open).

4. Stuck or lost: open group PRs (8):
- srs#1021 docs, three relation-layer statements (#1018): approved twice (latest 12 Nov), `gate:auto-merge`, no auto-merge armed, state `unstable`, 4 days. Waits on the merge step.
- srs#1033, #1035, #1036, #1037: escalated by the reviewer as Door 3, owner's merge (see section 1). #1035 also carries a reject verdict note and a `pr-classification` check that failed before the label was set.
- srs#1034: escalated; `pr-classification` red until the PR body is fixed.
- srs-rust#1646 render composition --section (#1510): rejected, gate red (`site/public/cli` out of date), behind master. Builder's to fix, unchanged for 3 days.
- srs-web#782 type subtypes from the core (#336): rejected, merge conflict, unchanged for 4 days.
Stops (needs-input): as in the last report (srs-rust#1495, #1164, #731, srs-web#691, #632); not re-read. No red gates reported by runs. Merged PRs without a quorum line: none. Owner-ruled escalations missing from either log: not re-checked this cycle.

5. Budget: 3 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 8 open. Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: the five proposed decisions in section 1 are the only ones pending. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: open `ready` + `wg:third-party-ready` issues (not PRs): srs 2, srs-rust 10, srs-web 1, srs-vscode 0, semanticops.com 0 (13; some blocked or already landed). Top 3 in builder order (all P2, oldest first, skipping stopped and landed ones): srs-rust#1339, srs-rust#1496, srs-rust#1635. Local priorities: none set. Queue fed for about 1 cycle at 10 a day. Waits on the owner: the five decisions and the five Door 3 merges. Fed by the analyst: 2026-11-11 (filed 10 rulings, unparked 4).

6b. Exercises: not re-read this cycle; the open ones in the last report stand.

7. What we learned: the pause lifted on your 👍 and the group merged three PRs within hours, so the pause rule worked as written. A new pattern: five Door 3 PRs that execute your own rulings all stopped at the boundary, which is the question in the new decision. The lesson to watch: a ruling is executed twice, once by words in an RFC and once by a merge, and the second adds no judgement. Build trigger (about 10 ratified decisions across both logs, then srs-web#560): not counted exactly, not flagged. Measurement I1: 0 of 0 PRs merged in the window grounded (the window opens at the 11:30 `cycleStart`, so it is empty); result 8e866224-a9d7-4ea6-a598-2bdd46c8cb5d (records/tier-2/measurement-result-8e866224.json). Whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
